Carry _target_'s letter to _ruler_ in Sentinel

branches.text: Whose hands will the dying man's letter reach?

choices.text: Give it to the man it names

branches.text: The traitor has fled. The Queen asks you to go after him.

outcomes.text: You sold the dead man's letter to the traitor it named.
The traitor is dead and the Queen remembers who did it.
The traitor slipped away, but the Queen knows you tried.
The Queen has the letter. What she does with it is hers to decide.
The Queen has the letter, but _traitor_ was never run to ground.
The letter never reached anyone who could use it.
